description: The file 'crosvm_builder.h' declares the 'CrosvmBuilder' class, which provides an interface for constructing and configuring a command to run Crosvm, a virtual machine monitor used in Android's crosvm-based virtualization environment. It includes methods for adding CPUs, disks, sockets, and other VM device configurations.

classes.name: CrosvmBuilder
classes.description: A builder class for assembling the Crosvm command with various virtual device and configuration options.

methods.name: ApplyProcessRestarter
methods.description: Configures the command to restart the process with given parameters.

methods.name: AddControlSocket
methods.description: Adds a control socket to the VM configuration.

methods.name: AddCpus
methods.description: Adds CPU configuration to the VM, either by count with a config path or via JSON.

methods.name: AddHvcReadWrite
methods.description: Adds a read-write HVC device with specified output and input.

methods.name: AddKvmPath
methods.description: Adds a path for KVM device.

methods.name: AddSerial
methods.description: Deprecated method to add serial device.

methods.name: AddTap
methods.description: Adds a TAP network device (Linux only).

methods.name: AddVhostUser
methods.description: Adds a vhost-user device with specified type, socket, and max queue size.

methods.name: HvcNum
methods.description: Returns the number of HVC devices added.

methods.name: Cmd
methods.description: Returns a reference to the command object being built.
